The '''Ancient Guardian Droid''' was a large and ancient [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] that was used by [[Tenebrae]] to guard [[Ancient Temple|one]] of his [[Emperor's Vaults|secret vaults]] on [[Nathema]]. The droid was destroyed by the [[Eternal Alliance]] during the [[Mission to Nathema (Zildrog)|search]] for the [[Zildrog]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].<ref name="TOR:TNC" />
